title: WaitlistOffered
description: Emitted by booking-service (via the transactional outbox) when a freed seat is offered to the oldest waitlist entry. The offer is backed by a real 10-minute hold (holdId) owned by the offeree. Topic: seatsync.waitlist.offered. Delivery: at-least-once; consumers dedupe on messageId.

messageId.description: Unique per emission (outbox row id); consumer dedupe key

holdId.description: The system-created offer hold reserving the seat for the offeree

eventId.description: Catalog event id (also the Kafka message key)

userEmail.description: Recipient address (sandbox domains like .local are valid here)
